mapper.select: SELECT s.event_id, k.session_id FROM ticket_skus k JOIN event_sessions s ON s.id = k.session_id WHERE k.id = #{skuId}
SELECT status FROM events WHERE id = #{eventId} FOR SHARE
SELECT starts_at FROM event_sessions WHERE id = #{sessionId} FOR SHARE
SELECT id, session_id, name, price_cents, total_stock, available_stock, created_at, updated_at FROM ticket_skus WHERE id = #{skuId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE ticket_skus SET available_stock = available_stock - 1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{skuId} AND available_stock >= 1
UPDATE ticket_skus SET available_stock = available_stock + 1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{skuId} AND available_stock < total_stock
